Archival Dispatch: 12 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Humphrey Bogart & Bacall Bold Venture, Iwo Jima Marine Documentary, and Vincent Price

Batch 103 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 103 recovers and dates 12 extraordinary recordings capturing Hollywood legends, live battlefield reportage, post-WWII veteran homecomings, macabre radio drama, big band swing, and country music history: Humphrey Bogart and Lauren Bacall trading hardboiled quips in Bold Venture (1951), Bogart guest starring alongside Edgar Bergen and Charlie McCarthy on Chase & Sanborn (1944), legendary WTIC broadcaster Bob Steele live at Bradley Field greeting returning WWII combat soldiers on transport planes (June 1945), master of the macabre Vincent Price hosting a chilling special Halloween dramatic feature 'Harry Tallow's Headaches' (1974), the official U.S. Marine Corps wartime documentary on the bloody assault and flag-raising in 'The Battle for Iwo Jima' (1945), Harry James and His Music Makers broadcasting live from the Chatterbox Club (1944), Texas Troubadour Ernest Tubb performing 'Thanks a Lot' on the Louisiana Hayride in Shreveport (1964), and harmony duo Wiley Walker & Gene Sullivan singing 'The Washington and Lee Swing' (1948).
